findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_search, web_read, company_enrich, email_verify, shopify_lookup · Private data: catalog_read, email_verify, token_check, address_check, memecoin_screen, memecoin_holder_trace, memecoin_backtest, memecoin_exit_check, memecoin_watch, x402_lookup, data_tool_run · Public sink: web_read, company_enrich, email_verify, memecoin_backtest, memecoin_watch, shopify_lookup · Destructive: memecoin_screen, memecoin_exit_check, memecoin_watch, data_tool_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web_search, web_read, company_enrich, email_verify, shopify_lookup · Private data: catalog_read, email_verify, token_check, address_check, memecoin_screen, memecoin_holder_trace, memecoin_backtest, memecoin_exit_check, memecoin_watch, x402_lookup, data_tool_run · Public sink: web_read, company_enrich, email_verify, memecoin_backtest, memecoin_watch, shopify_lookup · Destructive: memecoin_screen, memecoin_exit_check, memecoin_watch, data_tool_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
